articles.title: Dez integrantes de torcida Bamor, do Bahia, são presos acusados de tortura na sede do grupo em Salvador | G1
articles.standfirst: Investigação do MP aponta que presidente e diretores usavam martelos, facas e tacos contra membros sob pretexto de apurar desvios internos.
articles.summary: Investigação do MP aponta que presidente e diretores usavam martelos, facas e tacos contra membros sob pretexto de apurar desvios internos.
articles.body:
Dez integrantes da Bamor, a maior torcida organizada do Esporte Clube Bahia, foram presos acusados de promover sessões de tortura física e psicológica na sede da entidade, em Salvador. Entre os detidos estão o presidente da agremiação, Matheus Pires Castro, e o vice-presidente, Luciano Silva Venâncio.

A investigação aponta que a cúpula da torcida realizava os atos de violência no subsolo do imóvel para obter confissões sobre supostos desvios internos de dinheiro. Mensagens de áudio enviadas pelo presidente ao grupo da diretoria revelam o planejamento das agressões: "Aí, amanhã a gente vai pegar ele daquele jeito vai ser uma cena triste", diz Matheus em uma das gravações, completando com instruções para levarem alicates para arrancar unhas e afirmando que o alvo teria a "mão esmagada".

Segundo as apurações do Ministério Público da Bahia (MP-BA), os espancamentos ocorriam na sala da diretoria e duravam horas. Uma das vítimas integrou a organizada por 18 anos, foi líder de arquibancada e cuidava do sistema de cadastro de associados. Ele relatou ter sido convocado sob acusação de ativar planos de sócios sem identificar repasses financeiros.

"A gente sentou em mesa de reunião, foi aí que começaram a me bater com o martelo primeiro, depois pegaram a minha mão, atravessaram minha mão de faca, me deram quatro facadas na mão e pegaram um taco de beisebol, de madeira, que começaram a deferir golpes de taco em mim. Botaram um saco na minha cabeça pra me sufocar."

Ele declarou que cerca de dez membros da direção participaram da agressão por quatro horas e fizeram ameaças contra sua família.

Outra vítima, que prestava serviços de tecnologia para a torcida e também nega qualquer fraude, afirmou ter passado pela mesma dinâmica ao sugerir levar o caso à polícia. "E aí eu comecei a ser agredido com esse taco de beisebol, nas pernas, no braço, nas costas, e aí na sequência muito chute, muito pontapé. Nessa sala estava o presidente, o vice-presidente", conta, acrescentando que o presidente dava ordens para matá-lo. Durante o espancamento, ele foi obrigado a fornecer senhas bancárias e teve mais de R$ 5 mil retirados de sua conta.

Ao procurar a Polícia Civil no dia seguinte, o rapaz recebeu ligações de integrantes da organizada tentando conter a denúncia, mas rebateu classificando o ocorrido como tortura. "Essas vítimas foram convidadas a ali comparecer e foram submetidas a intenso sofrimento, orquestrado, orientado e coordenado pela direção daquela entidade", afirma o promotor Tiago Quadros, do Grupo de Atuação Especial de Combate ao Crime Organizado (Gaeco).

No fim de setembro, uma operação conjunta do MP-BA com as polícias Civil e Militar cumpriu 15 mandados de busca e apreensão e prendeu os dez investigados. Na sede, os policiais apreenderam martelos, alicate e um taco de beisebol, reconhecidos pelas vítimas.

Os investigados foram denunciados por organização criminosa, tortura, roubo, extorsão e ameaça. De acordo com o delegado Ernandes Júnior, diretor do Denarc, integrantes do grupo já acumulavam antecedentes por homicídio, tráfico de drogas, estelionato e violência doméstica.

A defesa de Matheus Pires e Luciano Venâncio declarou em nota "que seus clientes são inocentes" e que "todas as medidas judiciais já estão sendo adotadas".

Os episódios ocorrem em meio a medidas para tentar conter confrontos entre torcedores na capital baiana. Desde 2017, os clássicos entre Bahia e Vitória são realizados com torcida única nos estádios, mas brigas generalizadas persistem nas ruas. No clássico de 23 de agosto, válido pela 24ª rodada do Campeonato Brasileiro, confrontos em vários bairros deixaram um torcedor do Bahia morto próximo ao Barradão e outro óbito sob apuração. Por conta disso, a Bamor e Imbatíveis, do Vitória, foram punidas com seis meses de proibição em eventos esportivos.

O Ministério Público ressalta a necessidade de responsabilizar judicialmente as práticas criminosas no ambiente esportivo. "Deveria ser uma entidade voltada a valorizar a diversão, a valorizar o esporte, a confraternização. Pratica no seu seio atos de violência dessa natureza", ressaltou o promotor Tiago Quadros.

Para a vítima que atuava no cadastro de sócios, a experiência deixou marcas profundas: "São atos que é difícil até de falar. Eles foram bastante claros que iriam me matar".

articles.title: José Mourinho says he would have left Real Madrid for country where he would be respected if he were in Vinícius Júnior’s place, explains why the Brazilian stayed
articles.summary: José Mourinho comments on Vinícius Júnior's decision to remain at Real Madrid, highlighting the player's strength amid scrutiny and pressure. Despite interest from Arsenal, Vinícius extends his contract to 2032. Mourinho contrasts Vinícius's decision with his own potential choices in a similar situation.
articles.body: José Mourinho believes Vinícius Júnior had good reason to leave Real Madrid this summer, even as the Brazilian chose to stay at the club he considers home. The winger turned down reported interest from Arsenal and signed a contract extension through 2032, but his decision has come amid a difficult spell in Madrid, with criticism from supporters and renewed questions about his treatment.Mourinho says he would have forced a move awaySpeaking ahead of Real Madrid’s match against Sevilla, Mourinho said Vinícius had shown considerable strength in remaining at the club despite the pressure surrounding him. The manager, who is now in his second spell at the Bernabéu, suggested he would have made a different decision if he were in the Brazilian’s position.“He's a fantastic guy, and it's easy to get along with him. I spend a few minutes alone with him every day. I value him immensely because he always manages to live and survive with a smile,” Mourinho said.“If I were in his shoes, I probably wouldn't be here. I would have forced a move to a country where he'd be respected, but out of loyalty to Real Madrid and love for the club, he stayed. He believes things can improve, and he still has that smile. Nothing and no one can take it away from him.”Mourinho’s remarks came after Arsenal reportedly pursued Vinícius during the summer, with Mikel Arteta looking to strengthen his squad as the Gunners aimed to retain their Premier League title and go one better in the Champions League after losing last season’s final to PSG. The Brazilian ultimately remained in Spain, signing a new deal that runs until 2032.Mourinho later made clear that he understood why the forward stayed, saying: “When he signed that contract, he signed it because Madrid is his home, and Real Madrid is his home.”He added: “What I said before was that I doubt I'd be able - as a player with lots of options - I doubt whether I'd be able to have his psychological strength, to hold on.”A difficult spell at the BernabéuVinícius has faced a turbulent period, with his form under scrutiny and sections of the Bernabéu crowd whistling him. The winger is also serving a four-match La Liga suspension after receiving a straight red card against Villarreal.His relationship with the supporters came into focus again during Real Madrid’s recent Champions League match against Roma, when Mourinho substituted him after 59 minutes with Madrid trailing 3-1. Vinícius had lost possession in the build-up to Roma’s second goal, while substitute Endrick helped inspire a comeback that ended in a 4-3 Madrid victory.The Brazilian was visibly frustrated at being withdrawn, but defended his reaction and said he wanted to remain on the pitch.“It’s only natural for me to be angry when I’m substituted, because I always want to play every minute, to be at my best and help the team,” he said.Vinícius insists his confidence will returnThe winger has also faced criticism amid a dip in form since Kylian Mbappé’s arrival from Paris Saint-Germain in 2024. Vinícius has been subjected to whistles, boos and jeers from sections of the Bernabéu crowd, while also facing scrutiny from the media and criticism on social media. However, he pointed to his progress since joining Madrid as an 18-year-old and rejected the suggestion that his current struggles would define him.“When I was 18, many people laughed at me, saying I wouldn't score any goals - and today, I have over 100 with this jersey. Many have doubted me... the good form will return, and the goals will come back; I'm certain of that - I have no doubt at all.”Vinícius was central to Madrid’s Champions League triumphs in 2022 and 2024, but the club are now chasing a response after two trophyless campaigns. They are also nine points behind Barcelona in the league title race, adding pressure to Mourinho’s attempt to restore Madrid’s momentum.For now, Vinícius remains committed to the club, while Mourinho’s comments underline how difficult he believes it can be to withstand criticism when a player still has other options.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Florentino Pérez told his inner circle he could sack José Mourinho if results fail to improve, Didier Deschamps linked as replacement: reports
articles.summary: With pressure mounting on José Mourinho at Real Madrid due to inconsistent results, rumors of a possible sacking have surfaced, linking Didier Deschamps as a potential replacement.
articles.body: José Mourinho’s return to Real Madrid was supposed to bring clarity and authority to a club accustomed to competing for the biggest prizes. Instead, an uneven opening to the season has put the Portuguese manager under pressure, with a report from Spanish journalist Sergio Valentín suggesting that Florentino Pérez has begun considering what happens if results do not improve. The same report names former France coach Didier Deschamps as a possible successor, although Real Madrid have not confirmed any plans to change managers.Pérez is reportedly weighing Mourinho’s future if results do not improveAccording to Sergio Valentín, a journalist with Spanish radio station Radio MARCA, Pérez has told people close to him that Mourinho could be dismissed if Real Madrid’s performances fail to improve in the near future. Valentín’s report also identifies Deschamps as a potential replacement should the president decide to part ways with the Portuguese coach.The claim has circulated through social media and other football outlets, but it remains a chatter rather than an official announcement from the club. There has been no official confirmation that Pérez has decided to sack Mourinho, approached Deschamps or settled on a successor.An important distinction as Mourinho remains under contract at Real Madrid until the summer of 2029. Any departure before then would require a decision by the club’s management, whose assessment is likely to depend on how the team performs in the coming weeks and months.Real Madrid’s league position has intensified the scrutinyMadrid have won six of their opening eight La Liga matches, drawing no games and losing twice, leaving them fourth with 18 points. They have scored 19 goals, conceded eight and hold a goal difference of plus 11, but sit six points behind Barcelona, who have made a perfect start.The league position is only part of the concern. Madrid have struggled to find consistency despite a substantial summer recruitment drive that brought in Yan Diomande, Denzel Dumfries and Bernardo Silva. The team’s performances have also exposed a sharp difference between their home and away form.At the Santiago Bernabéu, Madrid have remained dominant, while their away matches have proved far more difficult. The describe a 57 per cent drop in goals scored on the road, with each away fixture ending either in defeat or a late escape.Those problems have become harder to separate from the pressure surrounding Mourinho, whose appointment was expected to help Madrid impose themselves more reliably across the season.Vinícius Júnior’s suspension has added another complicationMadrid’s immediate concerns have also been sharpened by Vinícius Júnior’s four-match domestic suspension. The Brazilian was sent off after pulling an opponent’s hair during the match against Villarreal, and the ban rules him out of the upcoming El Clásico against Barcelona.Mourinho has reacted angrily to the decision, criticising the Spanish football authorities over the timing of the announcement, which came shortly before Madrid’s Champions League match against Roma. The suspension leaves the manager without one of his most influential attacking players for a crucial stretch of the campaign.The disciplinary issue does not, by itself, explain Madrid’s inconsistent results, but it adds pressure at a time when the club needs performances to improve and the title gap to narrow.Deschamps is the reported alternative if Madrid make a changeValentín’s report names Didier Deschamps as the possible replacement for Mourinho. The former France manager brings a substantial record at both international and club level, although the report does not establish that Real Madrid have contacted him or begun negotiations.Deschamps captained France to the 1998 World Cup and Euro 2000 as a player before building an accomplished coaching career. He led France to the 2018 World Cup title, the 2022 final and the 2021 Nations League trophy, remaining in charge of the national team through the 2026 World Cup.His club career included Monaco, where he won the French League Cup and reached the 2004 Champions League final, Juventus, whom he helped return to Serie A after relegation, and Marseille, where he won the French championship and domestic honours. His track record makes him a credible name in the conversation, but there is no indication that he is next in line for the Madrid job.Mourinho still has time to change the pictureFor now, the situation remains one of reported concern rather than a confirmed coaching change. Madrid have collected six league wins from eight matches, and Mourinho’s contract runs for nearly three more years, giving the club both time and a substantial decision to make.The immediate test is whether Madrid can address their away struggles, manage the consequences of Vinícius’s suspension and produce more consistent performances against leading opponents. articles.title: El Atlético resuelve el derbi en un solo acto
articles.standfirst: Los goles de Jensen (2), Segura y Fiamma sentencian al Madrid CFF en una primera parte inmaculada
articles.summary: Los goles de Jensen (2), Segura y Fiamma sentencian al Madrid CFF en una primera parte inmaculada
articles.body: El Atlético de Madrid se llevó el derbi madrileño ante el Madrid CFF (4-0), un partido donde las locales resolvieron en la primera parte; anotaron Jensen (2), Fiamma y Segura; tuvieron minutos Jenni y Gabi; y Lola fue expulsada con roja directa dando la alternativa en portería a Otermín. Segura tenía ganas de mostrarse ante su nueva afición y no tardó en ganarse el cariño del público que colgó el 'No hay billetes' en la Ciudad Deportiva rojiblanca. De sus botas nació la primera jugada de peligro del encuentro, una asistencia a Gio que la brasileña no supo aprovechar al estrellar el mano a mano en el cuerpo de Ulloa. La de Badalona aprovechó poco después un pase filtrado de Fiamma para quebrar a Taylor en la frontal y probar suerte ante Ulloa, cuyo rechace aprovechó Jensen para estrenar el marcador. Y, apenas dos minutos después, fue la propia Celia la que firmó una gran jugada por el costado zurdo, zafándose de la marca de Lejeune y batiendo a la meta rival con un potente disparo cruzado. Volvería a marcar Segura pasada la media hora de juego aprovechando el rechace a un disparo de Fiamma -tras asistencia de la propia Celia-, pero el FVS lo anuló en fuera de juego. La campeona del mundo Sub'19 forzó poco después un penalti, por falta de Lejeune, que acabaría anotando Fiamma para ampliar la distancia en el marcador. Ya en tiempo de añadido, Jensen, que firmó un doblete echó prácticamente el cerrojo al choque. El resultado dio pie a que el técnico local pudiera dar minutos a jugadoras como Jenni o Gabi que llegaron al equipo con falta de rodaje. El Atlético acabó el partido con una jugadora menos por expulsión con roja directa de Lola, que paró con las manos fuera del área un disparo de Nautnes. Con todas las permutas hechas, fue Otermín quien se puso bajo palos, pero ni por esas pudo el Madrid CFF maquillar el resultado.

articles.title: Matarazzo: "Jugamos el mejor fútbol ofensivo, hicimos cinco goles y pudieron ser más"
articles.standfirst: El técnico de la Real se mostró muy feliz con el triunfo por goleada en Málaga
articles.summary: El técnico de la Real se mostró muy feliz con el triunfo por goleada en Málaga
articles.body: Pellegrino Matarazzo se mostró muy feliz por ver una gran versión ofensiva de su Real Sociedad y los cinco goles que logró, teniendo más ocasiones como para dejar claro que la victoria en Málaga fue merecida. Matarazzo habló sobre la holgada victoria de su equipo. “Necesitaría pensar en todos los partidos para saber si es la victoria más satisfactoria. Creo que empezamos el partido muy bien, algo importante en un estadio como este, nos mostramos de la manera que queríamos, jugamos un muy buen fútbol ofensivo, probablemente el mejor en mucho tiempo, marcamos cinco goles y pudimos haber marcado más, porque dispusimos de muchas oportunidades. Siempre hay cosas que mejorar, pero hoy saco muchas positivas”. El técnico insistió en la faceta ofensiva. “Queríamos hacer un buen y enérgico fútbol ofensivo hoy, dominar el partido, crear ocasiones, tener jugadores en el área, y lo hicimos. Fue bueno e importante hacerlo en todas las fases del juego. Estoy muy feliz con el rendimiento a nivel ofensivo”. Take Kubo y Mikel Oyarzabal marcaron sus primeros goles de la temporada. “El gol de Take fue fantástico. Estoy muy feliz de cómo vino a disputar el partido, muy enfocado y determinado. Se notó que quería mostrar lo que puede hacer y lo hizo. Fue una muy buena primera mitad de Take y un gol precioso. Y Mikel es un profesional de primer nivel, que quiere ganar cada partido, incluido cada partido de entrenamiento, porque es muy competitivo. Por eso está donde está y es la estrella que es, porque tiene ese gen de competir por completo. Eso es lo que nos encanta de él y, al mismo tiempo, es humilde y un gran líder”. Hubo más futbolistas que salieron reforzados de La Rosaleda, como Fort, Guedes, Óskarsson… “Esta era una gran oportunidad para nosotros de crecer como equipo y lo hicimos. Muy buenas actuaciones hoy de Héctor, por la forma en que defendió, también conectando con Take... Su juego ofensivo es muy bueno con el balón y nos da mucho. Aihen tuvo una actuación muy sólida, Gorrotxategi, los centrales... Tuvimos a muchos jugadores hoy que lo hicieron muy bien, y eso es seguramente positivo, porque entonces tienes más y más competencia y así es como alcanzas tu rendimiento máximo”.

articles.title: Funes, tras el 2-5: “Mi confianza en el proyecto está intacta”
articles.standfirst: El técnico pide más tiempo para sus jugadores
articles.summary: El técnico pide más tiempo para sus jugadores
articles.body: El Málaga CF recibió un duro correctivo ante la Real Sociedad en La Rosaleda. La goleada (2-5) dejó tocado al equipo de Juanfran Funes, que volvió a marcharse sin la victoria y evidenció sus problemas defensivos. El técnico de Loja compareció tras el encuentro para analizar una derrota que calificó de “muy cruel”, especialmente por la forma en la que se produjo y por no poder regalarle a la afición el primer triunfo en casa. Funes reconoció que el encuentro ante los donostiarras y el disputado frente al Villarreal han sido los dos días más duros desde su llegada. El entrenador pidió autocrítica, empezando por sí mismo, pero defendió el esfuerzo de sus futbolistas. “Nos ha costado mucho llegar hasta aquí como para bajar los brazos. Están poniendo todo lo que tienen y más para salir adelante”, aseguró, convencido de que el equipo ha hecho méritos para sumar más puntos de los que refleja la clasificación. El preparador malaguista también respaldó a sus jugadores, a los que se refirió como los ‘bichos’. “Mi confianza en ellos es ciega”, afirmó. Funes recordó la dificultad del calendario y lamentó que los goles encajados hayan condicionado partidos en los que el Málaga se había sentido capaz de competir. Además, señaló la falta de contundencia en las áreas como uno de los aspectos que deben corregir: “Si no hay contundencia en las áreas, es complicado hacer otras cosas durante los partidos”. Sobre la apuesta por la doble punta desde el inicio, explicó que buscaba aprovechar los espacios que dejaba la Real Sociedad al jugar con muchos futbolistas por delante del balón. Sin embargo, reconoció que el rival hizo daño por el centro y que el marcador obligó a modificar el planteamiento. “Dependiendo de los rivales y de las circunstancias, tomaremos decisiones”, apuntó sobre una fórmula que no fue habitual durante la pasada temporada. Pese al golpe, Funes aseguró sentirse fuerte y pidió a sus jugadores que no pierdan la fe. El técnico ya mira al próximo compromiso liguero, el viernes ante el Deportivo Alavés, y considera que la reacción debe comenzar de inmediato. “Vamos a permitirnos caer, pero hay que levantarse”, señaló, antes de pedir al vestuario que convierta la semana en una oportunidad para preparar un partido que considera clave. Por último, el entrenador fue rotundo sobre su continuidad en la idea que ha llevado al Málaga hasta Primera División. “Este es nuestro proyecto y ese proyecto nos ha traído hasta aquí”, defendió, poniendo en valor el crecimiento de una plantilla con futbolistas que hace tres años competían en Primera RFEF. “Si somos capaces de encadenar varios partidos sumando puntos, será determinante, porque tenemos talento y capacidad de crecimiento. Mi confianza en el proyecto está intacta”, concluyó.

articles.title: El Mourinho que reclama el Bernabéu
articles.standfirst: La contracrónica del Real Madrid - Sevilla
articles.summary: La contracrónica del Real Madrid - Sevilla
articles.body: Mourinho hizo ante el Sevilla lo que muchos esperaban que hiciera cuando se hizo con las riendas del equipo. Fue justo con lo sucedido ante la Roma y premió a Endrick con la titularidad. Meritocracia pura y dura, justo lo que reclama el Bernabéu. También se atrevió con Valverde, al que mandó al lateral derecho, aunque al uruguayo no le entusiasme jugar ahí. Mourinho sabe lo que piensa Fede, pero puso por delante las necesidades del equipo. Y, sobre todo, entregó el mando a Arda Güler. El turco asumió la dirección del juego y el Madrid fue otro. El equipo firmó uno de sus mejores partidos de la temporada y no parece casualidad. Mourinho movió piezas que parecían intocables y encontró una respuesta coral que al madridismo le hace ser un poco más optimista. Habrá que ver si mantiene la apuesta en el Camp Nou. Y un último detalle. Nada menor. Nadie echó de menos a Vinicius. Una noticia preocupante para el brasileño, que empieza a quedarse sin argumentos para reclamar su sitio como indiscutible. Diomande ofrece un trabajo defensivo y un compromiso colectivo muy superiores, además de aportar profundidad y desequilibrio. Si Mourinho apuesta de verdad por la meritocracia, aquí también tiene una decisión importante que tomar. Aunque eso será a partir de noviembre... El Madrid se fue con ventaja al descanso con dos obras de arte. El primero que la pintó fue Güler, que puso en la escuadra un balón que le cayó en la frontal desde el perfil izquierdo. Un golpeo precioso y preciso, acariciando y envolviendo la pelota para dibujar una trayectoria que se alejara del alcance de Vlachodimos. Golazo. Luego llegó Kylian para hacer su mejor gol con la camiseta del Real Madrid. Recibió de espaldas y se giró con un toque, como un bailarín, para irrumpir en el área con un trueno y sentar al portero del Sevilla con un toque y definir con otro. Tic-tac. Y El Bernabéu entregado al delantero francés. Mourinho sigue tocando teclas en busca del mejor Madrid, aunque para ello tenga que cambiar su plan inicial. Y eso es una buena noticia. El doble pivote Valverde-Tchouaméni parecía inamovible, pero Mou dejó claro que está dispuesto a revisar sus propias decisiones. Mandó al uruguayo al lateral y entregó el timón a Arda Güler, que respondió con un recital. También premió los méritos de Endrick con un puesto en el once. Retoques que dicen mucho de un entrenador que sigue buscando soluciones y que pueden ser claves para lo que resta de temporada. El Madrid disfrutó ante el Sevilla de la mejor versión de Cucurella. Intenso, agresivo, profundo… El Bernabéu vio por fin al Cucu de la selección, un lateral capaz de hacerse dueño de su banda. Y no parece casualidad que su mejor partido coincidiera con la presencia de Diomande por delante. El costamarfileño ofrece un trabajo que es una bendición para Cucurella y para el resto del equipo. Un despliegue que merece reconocimiento en un equipo en el que a los delanteros les cuesta remangarse. Hasta en los días plácidos, Courtois tiene que aparecer. El belga se fue a casa con dos paradones para que la victoria no corriera peligro. En la primera parte, una mano abajo a tiro de Agoumé para evitar que el Sevilla pusiera el 2-1 en el marcador. Con 3-0, en la segunda, otra buena intervención a disparo de Fofana. Los paradones de todos los días. Diomande quería su gol y no paró hasta conseguirlo. Llegó con un violento derechazo para cerrar la goleada y hacer más visible aún la brecha de rendimiento que existe hoy con Vinicius, al que nadie echó de menos. Diomande no estuvo especialmente fino en los metros finales, pero fue un martillo pilón durante todo el partido, sin parar de intentarlo en todo el encuentro. Lo que antes era Vini, vamos. Youssouf Fofana firmó un encuentro más que notable en el Bernabéu pese a la goleada encajada. Su llegada ha supuesto un impulso para un equipo que necesitaba futbolistas capaces de marcar diferencias. Un jugador que ha elevado el nivel general del equipo y que da argumentos al equipo para mirar más arriba de lo que lo ha hecho esta temporada.

articles.summary: El turco, protagonista con su golazo y con una acción previa con Peque que no interpretó Busquets como agresión. Mbappé, doblete, y Diomande completan ante un Sevilla indignado
articles.body: El Real Madrid sacó adelante el compromiso previo al Clásico mejorando juego y sensaciones, con Güler en el eje de todo. El turco fue determinante abriendo el partido con un golazo minutos después de un lance con Peque en que se reclamó agresión. Arda se jugó la roja, cierto, tanto como que mejora el juego blanco en el eje. También fue más compacto el Madrid con Valverde en una banda y Diomande en la otra. Mejoró a Vinicius, es un hecho. El Sevilla compitió con orgullo, cargado de indignación. Jugó bien, y las decisiones arbitrales cayeron en su contra. Una sanción y una decena de partidos devolvieron al Madrid a la casilla que ocupó hace un año. Mourinho repasó datos y estadísticas para colocar, en el penúltimo ensayo antes del Camp Nou, a Valverde en el carril derecho y a Güler en el eje del juego. Aquella apuesta le costó a Xabi el primer choque con la plantilla, y después de dos correcciones para ganar dos partidos complejos (Villarreal y Roma), el uruguayo se colocó en banda, con Trent y Dumfries disponibles. Vamos, que no fue un recurso desesperado. Fede fue todo. Lateral, interior y extremo. Suya fue la primera opción clara de un partido que nació reivindicativo. Diez minutos de gritos contra Tebas, Laporta, Negreira y la Federación. Total, que al poco de acabar la protesta se infiltró Bellingham por la derecha, metió el pase atrás y asomó Valverde en la frontal para conectar el derechazo. Lo sacó Mbappé con la espalda. El Sevilla, que llegaba al Bernabéu compartiendo enfado con los árbitros (con razón), arrancó sufriendo y cuando más cómodo se sentía en el partido, redobló su indignación. Sin Isaac Romero, Luis García colocó a Robbie Ure en punta y a Peque a su espalda con doble función, hurgar entre líneas y vigilar a Güler. En esas estaba cuando sujetó a Arda en una contra y el turco se revolvió. Peque cayó fulminado, pareció por un codazo. Los hispalenses reclamaron, pero Cuadra Fernández en el VAR no debió encontrar ninguna imagen clara y manifiesta de la agresión. Aunque se intuía más incluso que el tirón de pelo de Vinicius. Para colmo de casualidades, siete minutos después, Diomande, generoso con y sin balón, retrasó desde su costado y Arda, de primeras, colocó de zurda en la escuadra contraria. El Sevilla se juntó como una piña antes de reanudar el juego. Bien organizado, había encontrado buenas rutas de escape a la presión del Madrid, y buscó mantenerse en partido. Le costó porque, con resultado a favor, aparecieron las virtudes de la apuesta blanca. Endrick buscó profundidad a pierna cambiada, Bellingham apareció como llegador y Güler lució pase. Como en un servicio a Valverde que el uruguayo sirvió al área pero no conectó con Mbappé. El francés se reservaba su momento estelar. Buscó la contra el Sevilla, forcejeó Ure con Konaté, con agarrones incluidos, pero controló Courtois, abrió a banda, la pelota llegó a la frontal, taconeó Bellingham y Kylian dibujó un golazo: giro, recorte seco a Salas, uno-dos ante Odysseas y a la jaula. Pidieron los sevillistas falta previa, como la mano del Cucho un día antes. Nada que rascar. Intentó descontar el Sevilla antes del descanso, pero el tiro seco de Agoume encontró una mano prodigiosa de Courtois. Determinante. Cambió la banda derecha Luis García tras la pausa, Ejuke por Vargas. No cambió la queja de la grada por los arbitrajes, pese a flotar en el ambiente que en esta ocasión no había motivo. Más bien al contrario. Pudo aprovechar Diomande un error de Juan Iglesias y una pared en la medular que le permitió irse solo a la frontal. Le faltó finura en el último toque en ambas acciones mientras el recién ingresado Ejuke sacaba de punto a Cucurella. Por ese sector le dobló Juan Iglesias, que picó al segundo palo donde voleó Correia. Salvó Valverde, providencial, manteniendo la renta intacta para la sentencia. Llegó en un pase profundo de Diomande a Mbappé que el francés convirtió en penalti al cruzarse a la espalda de Castrín. Claro. Kylian modificó la solución y ejecutó un Panenka perfecto. Y como en el primer acto volvió a aparecer a continuación Courtois para asegurar la renta. Llegó bien el Sevilla a la frontal, remató Fofana y sacó el belga. Mourinho usó los cambios con sentido. Se fue Güler con el estadio en pie. Minutos para Bernardo y Brahim, ausente desde su actuación ante el Inter. El caso es que bajó algo la tensión blanca y lo aprovechó el Sevilla. Avisó Manu Bueno tras una falta ensayada, el mismo protagonista que castigó una pérdida de Mbappé para convertir un gran tanto, raso y con la zurda. No tuvo apenas tiempo de disfrutarlo, porque Diomande cerró el asunto con otro gran gol, arrancando desde la izquierda y conectando un derechazo imponente. Ahí acabó un duelo del que se quejará con razón el Sevilla, todas las decisiones arbitrales le fueron en contra. Con polémica o sin ella, el Madrid mejoró en juego, en intención y variantes. Más compacto. Habrá que ver si esta versión es suficiente para cortar el paso al Barça.

articles.title: Mourinho: "¿La posible roja a Güler? No entiendo la obsesión por algo que no se ha visto que ha pasado"
articles.standfirst: El técnico valora el contundente triunfo del Madrid ante el Sevilla y la polémica arbitral
articles.summary: El técnico valora el contundente triunfo del Madrid ante el Sevilla y la polémica arbitral
articles.body: Tercera victoria consecutiva del Real Madrid y otra más de manera contundente en el Bernabéu. El Madrid evita sustos antes del Clásico y despacha un partido envenenado ante el Sevilla. Mourinho valoró la nueva victoria, con la que su equipo recupera la dinámica positiva de resultados en un momento decisivo, y también la polémica arbitral en la acción de Güler, por la que el Sevilla pedía la roja directa. Las críticas del Sevilla al árbitro: "No comento. Quiero escapar de las palabras de Luis García, no de la polémica. Nadie me ha conseguido hacer ver lo que dicen que ha pasado, no tengo ni una sola imagen. He pedido imágenes a todos, también a mi staff, y no he conseguido ver ninguna imagen de las cosas que están hablando y que han molestado a Luis. Os digo con toda la honestidad que si un día pasa algo que nos ha beneficiado no tendré ningún problema en salir y decirlo. Pero creo que nos va a pasar mucho más lo opuesto porque es la tendencia natural. Si hasta el sábado alguien me hace llegar una imagen clara de algo que no he visto y que Güler también dice que no ha pasado, ahí estaré. Pero de momento, nada. Os pregunto: ¿Algunos ha visto una imagen clara? No entiendo la obsesión por algo que no se ha visto que ha pasado". Si temió perder a Güler para el Clásico con la posible expulsión: "No he pensado en el Clásico ni un minuto. Después de perder le preguntas a un entrenador por un caso (el de Güler) en el que no hay caso y para él es fantástico porque le das la oportunidad de hablar de otra cosa. Yo no he visto nada". Valoración del partido: "Ha sido un buen partido del equipo. Hubo muchos jugadores a un nivel alto, un partido que controlamos del primer al último minuto, tuvimos un porcentaje alto de posesión, hicimos buenos goles... Es una victoria bonita ante un buen rival al que respetamos. Jugamos muy bien". Cambios en el once pensando en el Barça: "No voy a pensar ni un solo minuto en nuestro próximo adversario en la Liga hasta que no acabe el partido del miércoles en la Champions. No hay un modo de saber qué jugadores merecen jugar. Hay mucha gente que no ha salido del banquillo que merecía jugar. El jugador que marcó el gol del triunfo en Roma estuvo en el banquillo. Ha sido un muy buen partido". La posición de Fede como lateral: "No tengo que convencerle de nada. Es el capitán del Real Madrid y si tiene que jugar de portero, jugará de portero. Para un entrenador dejar en el banquillo a dos laterales derecho de nivel es difícil, pero necesitábamos un lateral con más profundidad". La polémica arbitral en el Betis-Barcelona: "No vi el partido, te lo juro. Vi el Leipzig. Me llegaron informaciones al respecto, pero tampoco es sorprendente para mí".

articles.title: James McClean Says Poppy Row Made Him a Bit of a Recluse
articles.summary: James McClean says the fallout from refusing to wear the poppy “completely changed me as a person” and left him “a bit of a recluse”. The former Republic of...
articles.body:
James McClean says the fallout from refusing to wear the poppy "completely changed me as a person" and left him "a bit of a recluse".

The former Republic of Ireland winger last played for Derry City in July and describes the dispute as "player against owner".

McClean says he has been in contact with Misfits Boxing and wants to fight once his Derry contract expires.

Fourteen Years in England and One Decision That Followed Him Everywhere

James McClean knows how he is seen. "The perception of me is that, basically, I am a madman," he told the Guardian's Donald McRae. "The reality is quite the opposite. I'm pretty boring. I go training, go home and switch off."

The 37-year-old spent 14 years in English football and is now locked in a dispute with his own club, Derry City. He is the fifth-most-capped player in Republic of Ireland history with 103 appearances, and says he is the only footballer from the north of Ireland to win more than 100 caps for Ireland. He played 150 Premier League games over five seasons and about 800 professional matches. "I count that as success and don't look back with regrets," he said.

There is sadness in the story too. McClean says his refusal to wear the poppy when playing around Remembrance Sunday in England scarred his career. He said it had made him "a bit of a recluse" and that "I've been stung bad."

A Club Statement That Put All Eyes on Him

McClean was born in Derry in 1989 and grew up in Creggan, the estate that lost more people than any other on Bloody Sunday in 1972, when 14 unarmed civilians were killed by the British army. Six of the dead were from Creggan. "I grew up in a very Republican community still dealing with the effects of the Troubles," he said. "You would see gunmen on the street."

Steve Bruce signed him for Sunderland in August 2011 when he was 22. He made his Premier League debut that December after Martin O'Neill replaced Bruce, and his first season in England was full of joy and praise. "I never experienced any bother" up until November 2012, he said, when the poppy row began.

McClean told Sunderland he would not wear the poppy as it also represented the British army that had occupied Derry for so long. "Wearing the poppy was just never going to happen," he said. He recalled that the club issued a statement before the game saying it was his personal decision but that the club "wholeheartedly support the poppy appeal". He wanted to make his own statement, he said, but was told the row would die down. "I felt they hung me out to dry."

The next game was at Fulham, live on Sky. McClean said a threat was made that he would be shot if he came on to the pitch, and the night before the game two police officers were assigned to stand outside his door. "The Met police took it seriously and that made it more real," he said. O'Neill brought him on in the second half and every touch was booed by the Fulham and Sunderland supporters.

McClean moved on to Wigan, then West Brom, then Stoke, where he played 111 games between 2018 and 2021, and finally Wrexham from 2023 until earlier this year. The abuse followed him through each poppy season. "My reaction was always to fight fire with fire," he said, and he admits it affected how he played. "There were days where I went looking for the conflict," he said.

Did people understand his stance better by the time he reached Wrexham? "A wee bit, aye," he said. Explaining it to teammates and individuals opened their eyes. "But the overall British population? I don't think so."

McClean rejoined Derry City in January. "I was meant to be coming home for the fairytale ending," he said. His last appearance for the club came in July. "It's not good. It's a player against owner and there's only one winner," he said. "You never think you'll be betrayed by your own so it's painful."

A Derry City spokesman told the Guardian: "The club cannot speak to, or comment on, how James feels." He rejected the suggestion that the club had failed to fulfil any promises made to McClean. Earlier this month McClean said he could not "understand or accept" how he was being treated and that he was fit to play but had been left out of the squad by interim manager Mark Connolly. The club said it had sought to resolve the internal matter privately.

McClean has a plan if his football career is over. He has boxed off and on for 10 years and threw himself into it over the past 18 months. He has been in contact with Misfits Boxing, set up by KSI and the Sauerland brothers, and says they want him to fight. He does not see a professional career in the ring at his age, but three or four fights a year would suit him. "Boxing is giving me that purpose to wake up and train hard," he said. Asked how he feels about a possible end to his football career, he smiled. "It could end up a blessing in disguise." His autobiography, The Walls, is published by Sandycove.

articles.title: Studs and duds from Saints' dramatic Week 6 win over the Giants
articles.summary: Who made an impression in the New Orleans Saints' dramatic win over the New York Giants, for good reasons or bad? Let's break down Sunday's standouts.
articles.body:
Week 6 brought a dramatic finish to the New Orleans Saints ' win on the road against the New York Giants -- which isn't an ideal ending for a game they once led by three touchdowns. Some standout performers propelled the Saints to a big lead, but others got their hands dirty and let the Giants get right back into it. Here's a look at Sunday's Studs and Duds.

Kamara looked like the 2018 version of himself, making plays as a receiver (like his 31-yard touchdown reception), rusher () and even as a blocker, doing everything possible to keep his team in the game. He appeared to aggravate the back injury that's been bothering him for two weeks after laying out for an overthrown ball, but returned to action and continued to do his part. Kamara's touchdown catch put him at 90 scores in his career and punched his ticket for the exclusive club of players who have gained 5,000-plus yards as both rushers and receivers.

Come on, man. Staley overthought this one -- he repeatedly dropped some of his best pass rushers into coverage, leading to mismatches like Cameron Jordan guarding Giants superstar wideout Malik Nabers. He called a bad game once J.J. McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston at quarterback and allowed New York to score two quick touchdowns in the fourth quarter, forcing the offensive starters to come back into the game after they initially bowed out. We've given Staley excuses for having to work with poor personnel and key injuries at certain positions, but this was an example of his work at its worst.

Emerson had the game of his life, intercepting both Giants quarterbacks and only yielding four receptions for 38 yards, per Pro Football Focus charting. But he wouldn't have gone into the game at all if not for Kool-Aid McKinstry suffering migraines early on. Emerson was targeted ten times in coverage but only allowed a single first down conversion.

Pulling starters like Tyler Shough, Erik McCoy, and fill-in left tackle Asim Richards after going up 34-10 wasn't the problem -- doing so with more than 10 minutes left in regulation was. Moore should have given them more time to run out the clock and ensure there wasn't enough time left for the Giants to rally back. Instead, a rookie running back fumbled at midfield, leading to a quick Giants touchdown, and when the starters rushed back out there they went three-and-out in just over a minute. It took New York even less time to hurry downfield and score a second touchdown. Moore didn't manage this game well. It's clear he isn't used to working with a lead. Hopefully this was a learning experience for him.

Also, how many games does he need to watch Richards get beaten like a drum one-on-one before he decides to give the backup some help? The Saints don't have a better alternative, and Richards is not Kelvin Banks Jr. Moore can't stop treating him like he is and ask him to contain top-five draft picks like Abdul Carter on an island. What's the point of dressing out four tight ends on game day if you aren't going to park one of them next to Richards to make sure he's consistently getting help? Richards was flagged for back-to-back holding fouls early on because this isn't a job he can execute. Whether it's stubbornness or ignorance, Moore is sabotaging the player by putting him in this position.

The news that Shough has been playing with broken bones in his left hand wasn't very surprising. He hasn't looked like himself the last two weeks, but he made an admirable effort to keep drives alive and lead his offense on Sunday. Shough threw three touchdowns and scored another on the ground, but seeing him rush over and over again (including a 25-yard scamper to get inside the 10-yard line) was impressive. That he's engineering scoring drives under pressure is encouraging. Imagine what he can do when he has some healthy playmakers and an intelligent protection plan around him?

It was a mixed bag for Carlson, to say the least, as he had another kickoff fail to reach the landing zone paired with another missed field goal (this time from 55 yards). He did make two other tries from 51 and 58 yards, respectively, plus four extra points. But Carlson has proven he isn't the long-term answer. He's third in field goal hit rate (70%), with one of the two kickers worse than him already getting cut by their team (Harrison Mevis, at 55.6%).

articles.standfirst: El ex del Real Madrid podría debutar con los azulones este lunes, pero Bordalás mantiene el suspense y dice que hasta última hora no decidirá si juega o no. El Rayo regresa tras la suspensión ante el Athletic
articles.summary: El ex del Real Madrid podría debutar con los azulones este lunes, pero Bordalás mantiene el suspense y dice que hasta última hora no decidirá si juega o no. El Rayo regresa tras la suspensión ante el Athletic
articles.body: Dani Carvajal ha despertado la ilusión en el Getafe. Después de ejercitarse ya esta semana para comenzar su puesta a punto, hoy podría ser el día en el que se estrene con la camiseta azulona. Bordalás mantuvo este domingo el suspense sobre si el ex del Real Madrid estará en la lista y tendrá minutos. “No me gusta dar pistas. Dani viene trabajando fenomenal. Hasta mañana [por hoy] no tomaré la decisión. Ya veréis si juega o no. Está preparado como el resto de compañeros”, dijo. El defensa, que no compite desde la temporada pasada, afronta con muchas ganas esta nueva etapa. “Mi compromiso es máximo jugando en el Getafe, en el Real Madrid o haciendo una tortilla”, afirmó el pasado viernes en su presentación. Los de Bordalás reciben a los vallecanos con el choque de la Conference League aún en la retina. El equipo, que jugó hace apenas cuatro días, rotó en Rumanía en algunas posiciones. La principal duda reside en Carvajal, aunque también lo son Iván Azón, Enes Ünal y Mangala, que no estuvieron frente al Craiova. Además, Terrats y Andrés García son otros dos que están en el foco al haber sufrido algunas molestias en el choque europeo. Con poco rodaje y en busca de la normalidad, porque después de tres semanas de parón de selecciones, el equipo solo disputó algo más de trece minutos contra el Athletic antes de que se suspendiera el encuentro en el estadio de Vallecas. En el Coliseum se verá un once muy reconocible. Beñat podría volver a apostar por el equipo que salió ante los leones. La principal incógnita reside en esa mediapunta y en si el técnico decide alinear a Pedro Díaz o en su lugar apuesta por Isi como titular. Balliu sustituirá al aún lesionado Ratiu y De Frutos y Camello se sortearán el gol. Djené vs Lejeune. Son dos fijos en el eje de la zaga: 686 minutos ha jugado el azulón en lo que va de LaLiga y 655, el vallecano. Mantener la portería a cero será hoy fundamental... y eso dependerá en buena parte de la actuación de ambos. El viaje y el esfuerzo de la Conference pueden pasar algo de factura al Getafe, que tratará de compensar el cansancio con el aliento de su afición. El Rayo llega justo al revés, descansado tras la suspensión ante el Athletic, pero quizá aletargado después de mucho tiempo sin competir.

articles.title: Alabama Gets $500K from Tennessee as SEC Fines Vols for Storming Field After Upset Win
articles.summary: Alabama lost to Tennessee 26-10 in upset fashion on Saturday, marking its third loss to the Vols in the last five years.
articles.body:
Alabama lost to Tennessee 26-10 in upset fashion on Saturday, marking its third loss to the Vols in the last five years.

The silver lining in losing to their rival is that the Crimson Tide will get a hefty payment from the Vols. Since Tennessee fans stormed the field at Neyland Stadium, the school will have to pay Alabama $500,000.

In May, the SEC upped its fine for field and court storming to $500,000 per incident. Previously, schools were fined $100,000 for their first offence, $250,000 for their second offence, and $500,000 for their third offence.

"The motivation was 'field rushing is field rushing, the first time or the 18th time,'" commissioner Greg Sankey said about the decision to change the fine. "The random nature of, if you're the one getting rushed, it doesn't feel good. It might be the first time (it happened) there, but it might be your sixth time in a row, literally."

In 2022, Tennessee beat Alabama at Neyland Stadium to snap a 15-game losing streak to the Crimson Tide, and fans poured onto Shields-Watkins Field, celebratory cigars in hand.

After beating Alabama again in 2024, Vols fans once again celebrated the victory by coming onto the playing surface. Despite having several wins over the Tide in the last few years, the victory over their bitter rival led to another field storming on Saturday.

"This is without a doubt the best fan base in America," Tennessee coach Josh Heupel told reporters after the win. "They show up in an elite way every Saturday."

Alabama dropped to 5-2 with the loss, and the Tide are officially on a regular-season losing streak for the first time since 2007, which was Nick Saban's first year at the helm. They'll look to get back on track next week against Texas A&M.

Tennessee, meanwhile, improved to 6-1 and is building a solid College Football Playoff resume, with its only loss coming to Texas in September. The Vols will take on South Carolina on the road next week.

articles.title: Ajaraie brace powers NorthEast United to 4-1 rout of Kerala Blasters
articles.summary: Juan Pedro Benali started the season as the longest-serving coach of a single club in Indian Super League history.
articles.body: Juan Pedro Benali started the season as the longest-serving coach of a single club in Indian Super League history.And the team chemistry that he has been building since 2023 was on display at the Indira Gandhi Athletic Stadium in Guwahati on Sunday as NorthEast United FC put on a show for the home fans with a 4-1 win over Kerala Blasters, featuring a brace from Alaaeddine Ajaraie and contributions from across the pitch.While they played a defensive game for most of their opening fixture against Mohun Bagan Super Giant, the hosts began their second game with attacking intent, with Jithin MS and Ajaraie at the heart of their forward moves.But the breakthrough took 15 minutes to come for the hosts, in an immaculate show of understanding that has developed among Benali’s men. Eneko Satrustegui sent a long ball from beyond the halfway line towards the edge of the box and their talisman Ajaraie anticipated it perfectly, beating the advancing goalkeeper Arsh with his first touch before guiding the ball in with his second for the opener.Adrian Luna could have got the visitors an equaliser in the 38th minute, but he failed to connect with a cross from the left towards the far post.Soon after, in the 43rd minute, NEUFC were on the attack down the right flank and Jithin managed to escape the clutches of Blasters defender James Bolton in front of goal to guide a long ball with the back of his head towards the top corner. But young goalkeeper Arsh was up to the task, palming it away to safety.The pressure from NEUFC’s attackers finally led to a second goal in the fourth minute of injury time, courtesy of a defensive error from Sumeet, as Jithin won the ball inside the box and passed it to their Moroccan stalwart. Although Ajaraie’s shot was blocked by the Blasters defence, the rebound fell to Antony Moyano. The Spanish midfielder set himself up with his first touch before firing the ball into the far corner for the hosts’ second goal.The Blasters returned after the change of ends with more confidence and a change in tactics and personnel, and coach Ashley Westwood’s strategy paid off in the 60th minute.A perfect backheel from Luna set up Momo Yansane inside the box, and he kept his calm to slot home from an acute angle, between goalkeeper Gurmeet Singh and the right post, giving the Blasters belief that they still had 30 minutes to stage a turnaround.But Ajaraie, looking to take up his role as the ISL scoring machine, restored NEUFC’s two-goal lead 10 minutes later with a superb swerving finish into the far corner of the Blasters net, beyond the defender and goalkeeper.In a final blow to the visitors, substitute Aman CK, who had been on the field for less than 10 minutes, converted a NEUFC attack from the right in the 82nd minute to seal a convincing victory for the hosts.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Duke CB Kimari Robinson apologizes for swatting away athletic trainer: 'She did not deserve that'
articles.summary: A video of Robinson swiping at the trainer as she went to tend to an injured player went viral, following the Blue Devils' loss to UNC.
articles.body:
Duke cornerback Kimari Robinson publicly apologized for swatting at an athletic trainer who was tending to one of his teammates. The incident, which was captured on the broadcast and went viral, occurred during the Blue Devils' loss to UNC on Saturday after Duke safety DaShawn Stone went down in a scary moment.

In a statement posted to social media, Robinson apologized for his conduct, saying he had also apologized to the trainer in private after the game.

"I want to publicly apologize to the member of our training staff for how I acted toward her during Saturday's game. I was completely wrong, and she did not deserve that," Robinson wrote. "Immediately after the game, I apologized to her personally and checked to make sure she was okay."

Robinson added that his outburst stemmed from worry about Stone, who Robinson said "is like family."

"I was scared he might be seriously hurt. But being worried about him does not excuse how I treated her. I should have controlled my emotions, and I didn't," Robinson continued. "I'm truly sorry for my actions and for letting her, myself and our program down. I have to be better than that."

Stone went down in the third quarter of Duke's 24-20 loss to UNC, and stayed on the field for a while. A stretcher was brought out for Stone, but he ended up walking to the locker room under his own power.

Before Stone was able to walk off, however, Robinson stayed close to his teammate while he was being tended to. The trainer seemingly tried to nudge Robinson away from the scene, but he smacked her arm out of the way. Video of the incident went viral on Saturday, with many criticizing Robinson for the outburst.

Both Robinson and Stone are redshirt juniors in the Duke secondary, and have spent four years on the Blue Devils' roster together.

Duke's loss to its in-state rivals came after Tar Heels defensive back Kenton Dopson III picked off Blue Devils quarterback Walker Eget with 19 seconds remaining, sealing a four-point win.

articles.title: How NFL Week 6 could make dubious fantasy football history
articles.summary: Fantasy football scorelines are less gaudy than usual. Here's a potential reason why.
articles.body:
Fantasy football users, beware: this week's slate of games have been a little uglier than usual.

That's not to say you couldn't have done better in setting your lineup. You thought it was smart to start Darren Waller instead of an injured Tyler Warren. And your decision to place A.J. Brown back into your ranks after his weeks-long absence? Shameful.

Still, there was no way you could prepare for the lack of scoring that took place across the league. Points have been aplenty. But glittering individual outings — the type that light up the fantasy football marquee? Those have been more difficult to find.

With that, here's what you need to know about Week 6's place in fantasy football infamy through its first 12 games.

How Week 6 could make dubious fantasy football history

Clunkers — defined by astute observers as underwhelming performances by star players — have been an ever-present part of the fantasy football calendar.

Even by that standard, the Week 6 slate of games has been historically bereft of eye-catching displays. With one ga,e left on the weekly calendar, no player has eclipsed the 30-point mark, per NFL Fantasy Football . Not Josh Allen. Not Bijan Robinson. Not Jaxon Smith-Njigba. No one.

Some have flew closer than others. Malik Nabers' 12-catch, 165-yard day yielded 28.5 points for those fortunate enough to roster him on their fantasy squads. Kenneth Walker continued his strong start with the Chiefs , producing 128 yards and two rushing touchdowns — good for 27.9 points. Trevor Lawrence and Tyler Shough's four-TD days amounted to 27.3 and 27 points, respectively.

Nevertheless, none of the dozens of players who saw the field across the opening 12 games were able to touch that vaunted 30-point plateau. If that sordid run of form continues in the final two games of the week — Packers vs. Cowboys and 49ers vs. Commanders — it would make minor fantasy football history.

Per NFL Fantasy Football, the last time that a week failed to produce a 30-point scorer was in Week 13 of the 2009 season.

There's still plenty of time for some of the league's brightest stars to author up memorable showings and avoid that dishonor. The likes of Brock Purdy, Jayden Daniels and Christian McCaffrey all have eyes on eye-catching showcases under the bright lights.

Nevertheless, if the score of your fantasy football game looks a little less appealing that usual, this could at least partially explain it.

articles.title: Cowboys Bench $50 Million Pro Bowler After Costly Mistakes
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys are making moves on the roster and in the lineup, including putting struggling Jake Ferguson on the bench. The post Cowboys Bench $50 Mill...
articles.body:
While all eyes for the Dallas Cowboys have been on the defense to this point, with an emphasis on what changes would be made after last week's disastrous loss to the Buccaneers on Thursday night, the team also snuck in an offensive change as well. Tight end Brevyn Spann-Ford was moved into the starting lineup, replacing two-time Pro Bowler Jake Ferguson after Ferguson's dropped pass last week led to a game-sealing interception.

Ferguson, who is on a four-year, $50 million contract, has struggled all season. He has 15 catches for 102 yards in five games.

That's not to say that Ferguson was completely benched, but clearly, the Cowboys are seeking more accountability for players who have disappointed this far this season. The team came into 2026 talking about the Super Bowl and confident about its ability to contend in the NFC, but has been a massive disappointment through five games. While most of that disappointment has been on the defensive side, the play of Ferguson, as well as right tackle Terence Steele, has been problematic.

As longtime beat writer Clarence Hill of DLLS Cowboys wrote on Twitter/X: "Brevyn Spann Ford was announced as the starter at tight end over Jake Ferguson…That happened."

Ferguson was rated as the No. 10 tight end in football back in 2023 by Pro Football Focus , but has steadily declined since. This year, he has a rating of 49.0, which is 75th out of 81 tight ends in the game.

articles.title: Florida HC Jon Sumrall Explains Why Gators ‘Still Suck’ After Texas Win
articles.summary: It’s been a rollercoaster of a first season for Florida Gators head coach Jon Sumrall. Going into Saturday’s game, it looked like the Gators were in freefall...
articles.body:
It's been a rollercoaster of a first season for Florida Gators head coach Jon Sumrall. Going into Saturday's game, it looked like the Gators were in freefall. With a road trip to play the Texas Longhorns, a favorite to make the College Football Playoff, it seemed like things would only get worse.

Then, Florida pulled off a massive upset and came from behind to knock off Texas. All of a sudden, Sumrall and the Gators are trending up again.

In the 27-24 win, Florida turned to Tramell Jones as their starting quarterback. He was limited, only throwing for 155 yards and 2 touchdowns, but he also made winning plays, like scrambling for a first down late on a read option. Then, the defense came up big, with 5 sacks and a forced fumble to help put the game on ice.

Florida Gators HC Jon Sumrall Says They Still Suck

There was, obviously, plenty to like from Florida on Saturday. There were still things to work on. That's what Jon Sumrall tried to focus on, noting that he thinks that the Gators still suck. They might just suck a bit less now.

"In this game or in life," Sumrall said . "You don't get to go, 'Hey, I was good last week, so I get to be good next week, right?' I guess part of why we got our ass kicked in Missouri and last week at home is because everybody around Gainesville was patting our guys in the back telling them how good they were, and I'm like, guys, we suck. Like I've watched this practice, we're not very good. We still suck. We just suck less, all right. And so, we have to figure out to suck less each week."

The problem is that Florida still has some major issues to take care of. The secondary is susceptible to giving up big plays. The offense hasn't been consistent, coming off two blowout losses in SEC play before the Texas win.

Sumrall is being a bit harsh to say his team sucks. But his point is well taken. One great win doesn't make you a great team. It makes you a team that had a great win.

"But we're not like a complete team yet. So, this does nothing for us. What it does for us, it gets us another win. But the thing it does more than a ranked win or a road win or whatever those stats are, what it does for me, it gives me belief and hope that our guys understand you have to fight your tail off every time you play the game. … I'm just glad our guys brought it," Sumrall said.

The Florida Gators are going to head home to Gainesville now. There, they'll have a bye week to keep on improving and becoming the team that Sumrall wants them to become. They better take some strides, too, because there are no breaks in the schedule after that.

On Halloween, Florida will play its next game against the Georgia Bulldogs . One of the great rivalry games in the SEC, Georgia is coming off an upset loss last week and will also have a bye week to get right. So, the Gators should be ready for a massive fight.

A neutral-site game, this year's edition of the game is moving from Jacksonville to Atlanta. There, kickoff is scheduled for 3:30 p.m. EST on October 31st.

articles.title: Diomande aprieta a Vinicius
articles.standfirst: Al otro lado del espejo
articles.summary: Al otro lado del espejo
articles.body: Mourinho retocó el equipo, quitándole cemento y dándole juego con un simple cambio de posiciones de dos de sus hombres clave: Valverde dejó el doble pivote para pasar al lateral y Güler ocupó el centro del tablero, con Tchouaméni, para llevar la manija. Arriba, Endrick fue extremo derecho y Diomande izquierdo. Funcionó, aunque sin excesos. El equipo tuvo mejor posicionamiento en el campo, Güler manejó bien, Diomande mejoró las últimas prestaciones de Vinicius y la banda derecha Endrick-Valverde cumplió. El premio fue una goleada que, lástima, nació con una sombra, casi diría que un pecado original. El primer gol lo marcó Güler, un tirazo soberbio a pase de Diomande, un tanto sin nada que discutir en sí mismo, pero es que no hacía mucho tiempo que el turco se había librado de un agarrón insistente de Peque con lo que a todas luces pareció un codazo en la barbilla. La transmisión no nos mostró una imagen lo bastante clara como para jurarlo por estas que son cruces, pero en la única mostrada quedó esa impresión. El árbitro ni lo vio ni tenía por qué, pues el balón no estaba ahí, y, mientras Peque hacía la escena agónica de ritual en estos casos, el VAR expurgó todas las cámaras en busca de alguna imagen que todos necesitábamos para condenar a Güler o exonerarle, pero no apareció. Todo el sistema VAR está montado sobre un castillo de naipes que con un soplido se cae. El Sevilla quedó indignado, y más se enfadó aún con el segundo gol, una obra de arte de Mbappé, porque la jugada procedía de una recuperación de Konaté con visos de falta, que de nuevo el sistema arbitral ignoró. Con ese 2-0 fuimos al descanso. En fin, fue un mal día para que la grada de animación exhibiera esa pancarta contra Tebas y Negreira (con colores blaugrana), que por cierto la transmisión tampoco mostró, regalando la exclusiva a RMTV. Los sevillistas se dejaron el enfado en el vestuario e hicieron un segundo tiempo digno, pero el Madrid se les fue aún más lejos con un penalti que admitía poca discusión, pero que no dejará de aprovechar el bando antimadridista. Aun así, consiguió descontar, pero ese 3-1 lo convirtió Diomande en el 4-1 con otro gol soberbio que vino a premiar su gran partido, con incursiones, buenos envíos largos y estupenda actitud combinativa, además de trabajo incansable para ventilar atrás. Vinicius va a tener que atarse bien los machos si Diomande repite en los próximos partidos actuaciones así. Ahora la intriga es si Mourinho seguirá por esta línea o si en el Camp Nou volverá al doble pivote. Los gritos islamófobos en el España-Egipto nos cuestan una sanción de la FIFA: multa de 20.000 dólares (17.700 euros) y cierre del 15 % del estadio para el próximo amistoso de la selección en nuestro suelo. Importante lo de amistoso, pues no afectará al España-Inglaterra del 15-N en el Metropolitano, para el que ya está todo vendido. La Federación ha recurrido, así que ya veremos. Pero sería una triste gracia que por culpa de una punta de inadaptados sociales de Cornellà la próxima ciudad que acoja un amistoso se viera afectada. El cargo de Javier Tebas casaría mejor con la discreción que con esa incontinencia adolescente que le caracteriza en el uso de las redes sociales. Donde hay una bulla envía de inmediato su mensaje para acrecentarlo, un vicio que le crea problemas innecesarios. Ahora le ha dado munición a Florentino por su equiparación fea y excesiva de RMTV con Goebbels, el mago de la propaganda del III Reich. No creo que eso le dé al CSD para sancionarle, cosa que pide el Madrid, pero lo que sí hace es desgastar su figura institucional.

articles.title: El Barcelona, bajo mínimos atrás
articles.standfirst: Koundé, Eric García y Christensen no estarán contra el PSG
articles.summary: Koundé, Eric García y Christensen no estarán contra el PSG
articles.body: El Barcelona afronta el compromiso del martes contra el PSG con un margen de recuperación mínimo y numerosas bajas en su línea defensiva. Hasta tres zagueros no viajarán este lunes a París: Koundé, Eric García y Christensen, todos ellos lesionados. Además, Gerard Martín arrastra un golpe, aunque no debería tener problemas para jugar. La expedición azulgrana se desplazará este lunes a la capital francesa con solo cinco defensas del primer equipo: Cancelo, Espart, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín y Balde. No obstante, este último apenas ha entrado en los planes de Hansi Flick, ya que solo ha disputado 12 minutos en lo que va de temporada, contra el Racing de Santander. En el caso de Gerard Martín, tuvo que ser sustituido al descanso del partido contra el Betis. El defensa recibió un pisotón que le obligó a permanecer varios minutos en la banda mientras era atendido por los servicios médicos. En principio, está disponible para el encuentro contra el PSG, pero solo dispone de dos días para recuperarse por completo y poder afrontar con plenas garantías una cita tan exigente. Con Koundé, Eric García y Christensen fuera de la convocatoria, Hansi Flick deberá reorganizar su línea defensiva. En los laterales, Cancelo podría ocupar la banda derecha, mientras que Xavi Espart apunta a la izquierda, después de firmar muy buenas actuaciones. En el centro de la zaga, Cubarsí está al cien por cien y la principal incógnita es quién será su acompañante. Si Gerard Martín está completamente recuperado de sus molestias en el tobillo, formará pareja con el central catalán, como es habitual. Si Gerard no acaba de tener buenas sensaciones, el técnico deberá buscar alternativas más imaginativas o recurrir a La Masía. De Jong sería la opción más natural, pero el neerlandés recibió el alta médica el viernes tras lesionarse durante el Mundial y no disputó ni un minuto contra el Betis. Por lo tanto, está sin ritmo de competición. Rodri también ocupó el eje de la zaga cuando Eric García abandonó el terreno de juego en La Cartuja, pero Flick no renunciará del internacional en el centro del campo. Con este panorama, el técnico cruza los dedos para que Gerard Martín llegue al cien por cien.
